description: lareira-clickhouse values. Only the M0 ENJULHO `clickhouse.model` block is schema-constrained; the rest of the chart's values are validated at the template layer.

model.description: M0 ENJULHO: the ClickHouse schema as a typed analitico model rendered into a shinka DatabaseMigration CRD (values -> CRD -> reconcile). null/absent -> no DatabaseMigration is emitted.

name.description: enum ClickHouseModel { events }. M0 ships exactly the clustered, Keeper-replicated events model (analitico::Ddl::events).

connection.description: The CH connection the typed model converges against (renders spec.database.clickhouseRef).

host.description: CH HTTP host (CRD clickhouseRef.host), e.g. clickhouse.monitoring.svc.

cluster.description: ON CLUSTER distributed-DDL cluster (CRD clickhouseRef.cluster), e.g. tendril.

table.description: Table-name override (optional). "" -> the model canonical name (events); set e.g. events_m0 to prove a converge without clobbering a live events table.

credentialsSecretRef.description: Secret holding the CH password (CRD credentialsSecretRef).

name.description: Secret name. "" -> the chart's {fullname}-auth Secret (or clickhouse.auth.existingSecret).

passwordKey.description: Key within credentialsSecretRef (optional; CRD default clickhouse-password).

tables.description: DOCUMENTATION of the typed analitico model shape the shinka CH executor renders server-side. The model is a closed enum in analitico; these fields are the typed contract, not a knob (editing them does not change what shinka renders).
